name: chatgpt-bridge-lane
description: Talk to the local ChatGPT file bridge, send a variable prompt, and wait until the reply is a text file, a JSON object, or an image. Do not treat a written request as a returned object.
outputs: explicit stopped reason when the object did not arrive
permissions: write one request file under the bridge
run the lane sender only when that lane's script exists and its quota check allows it
rollback: Delete the skill folder. Sent bridge requests stay; correct one with a new id and parent_id.
provenance: Measured on the Risha assistant_bridge, 2026-10-14. Story lane, coordination lane, and image lane.
